help.faq.usCertificates.q: How do US resale certificates work?
help.faq.welcomeEmail.a: With “Send welcome email” on, Tradepass asks Shopify to send its own B2B welcome email. If Shopify doesn't let apps send it on your store, the approval still finishes and the application page offers a ready-made “you're approved” message. You can also send Shopify's B2B access email from the contact in Shopify admin, or automatically with Shopify Flow (trigger “Company contact assigned permission”, action “Send B2B access email”). That's the only email that goes out automatically, and Shopify sends it.
help.faq.welcomeEmail.q: Does the buyer get an email when I approve them?
